patterns.note: Full-bleed dark background sections with content centered horizontally, often featuring a prominent device illustration or large typography as a visual anchor.

Dramatic, oversized serif typography is used for the brand name and primary headings, creating a strong editorial and sophisticated feel, contrasted with a clean sans-serif for body text and UI elements.
A predominantly dark palette transitions from deep black in the hero to a dark teal/blue in subsequent sections, accented by bright cyan/blue for interactive elements and highlights.

The large 'Monologue' text in the hero section appears to parallax, moving slower than the foreground content as the user scrolls, eventually revealing a background color transition from black to dark teal.
Sections are clearly delineated by full-width background color changes and often introduce a central visual element, such as a stylized device or a grid of feature cards.

technique_notes: To rebuild the hero motion, use a scroll-triggered animation (e.g., GSAP ScrollTrigger) to create a parallax effect where the oversized brand name moves at a slower rate than the main content, giving a sense of depth. Simultaneously, trigger a background color transition for the main page wrapper as the user scrolls past the initial hero viewport.

Implement scroll-triggered reveals for content sections, where elements like text blocks and cards fade in or slide up from the bottom as they enter the viewport, using CSS keyframes or a JavaScript animation library.
Utilize a dark, full-bleed background for sections, with content constrained to a central column. Employ a distinct color shift for the background between major sections to visually separate them.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant serif display headings (~4-5x body) create a strong visual impact, complemented by a clean, legible sans-serif for body and UI text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (e.g., on buttons, cards, and device illustrations) provide a soft, modern touch without being overly rounded.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy; the hero section features very generous vertical spacing, while content sections maintain a clear, organized rhythm with ample padding around elements and between sections.

standout: The site's distinctive use of dramatic, oversized serif typography for the brand name and key headings, combined with a dark, industrial-chic aesthetic and a subtle background color transition on scroll, creates a sophisticated and memorable brand experience. The custom-designed device illustrations are also a unique visual motif.
